title: Belgium at the World Cup
description: The Red Devils and the golden generation — how well do you know Belgium's World Cup story?

questions.q: What is Belgium's best-ever result at a World Cup?
questions.explain: Belgium finished third at the 2018 World Cup in Russia, beating England 2–0 in the third-place play-off. It remains the high-water mark of their 'golden generation'.

questions.q: In one of the 2018 World Cup's greatest moments, Belgium came back from 2–0 down to beat Japan 3–2. Who scored the last-minute winner?
questions.explain: Nacer Chadli converted a Lukaku counter-attack in the 94th minute to complete a stunning comeback, sending Belgium into the quarter-finals.

questions.q: Belgium spent a record consecutive period ranked number one in the FIFA World Rankings. Roughly how many years did this last?
questions.explain: Belgium held the FIFA #1 ranking from September 2018 to October 2022 — nearly four years uninterrupted, the longest any nation had held top spot at that point.

questions.q: Who is Belgium's all-time top scorer?
questions.explain: Romelu Lukaku has scored more goals for Belgium than any other player in history, passing Dries Mertens' record to become their all-time leading scorer.

questions.q: Belgium also finished fourth at the 1986 World Cup. Which team beat them in the semi-final?
questions.explain: Argentina, inspired by Maradona, beat Belgium 2–0 in the semi-final at the 1986 World Cup in Mexico. Belgium lost the third-place play-off 4–2 to France.

questions.q: Which Belgian goalkeeper, widely regarded as one of the best in the world, won the Golden Glove at the 2018 World Cup?
questions.explain: Thibaut Courtois won the Golden Glove at Russia 2018, conceding only 3 goals in 7 matches. He plays his club football for Real Madrid.

questions.q: What is the nickname of the Belgian national football team?
questions.explain: Belgium are known as the Red Devils — De Rode Duivels in Dutch or Les Diables Rouges in French — named after their distinctive red kit and passionate style.

questions.q: Kevin De Bruyne is regarded as one of the world's best midfielders. Which English club does he play for?
questions.explain: Kevin De Bruyne has spent the prime of his career at Manchester City, where he has won multiple Premier League titles and the Champions League under Pep Guardiola.

questions.q: At the 2022 World Cup, Belgium were shockingly eliminated in the group stage — beaten by which African nation?
questions.explain: Morocco beat Belgium 2–0 in a famous 2022 upset, with goals from Abdelhamid Sabiri and Zakaria Aboukhlal. Belgium's golden generation bowed out without reaching the knockout stage.

questions.q: Eden Hazard announced his retirement from international football after which tournament?
questions.explain: Hazard retired from international football after Belgium's group-stage exit at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, ending a glittering but ultimately trophy-less international career.
